audit.whatIsWrong: Every stage except '2+ items' was marked Skill even though Sejuani wins 58.49% and both layers' prose says 'Everything changes at Level 6'.
audit.why: The chart never gave Maokai a stage, so it was not a hard contradiction, but it also never registered the level-6 flip the text describes. Handing Sejuani Level 6 and First item lines the chart up with both the prose and the win rate without inventing a shift that isn't there.
audit.corrected: win[4], win[5] and the matching phases[].side now read Sejuani.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 2-3 spike described Twisted Advance only as a root that lets him stick to you.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Maokai contorts into a mass of moving roots, becoming untargetable and dashing to the target.' The untargetable window is the spike's real content — it is what eats a mistimed Permafrost or Glacial Prison — and the ability is 14/13/12/11/10s.
audit.corrected: Spike now names the untargetable dash and the rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three separate errors: 'He has no dash' (whys[5]/mid), Bramble Smash called a knockup in places and a knockback in others, and Sejuani's armour called 'passive Permafrost armor'.
audit.why: Twisted Advance IS a dash, and an untargetable one. Bramble Smash 'knocks back nearby enemies' — knockback, not knockup. Sejuani's resistances come from Fury of the North (P) / Frost Armor, not from Permafrost (E), which is only the stun. Separately and most usefully: Sap Magic's heal cooldown 'is reduced each time Maokai casts a spell OR IS STRUCK BY AN ENEMY'S SPELL' — so every Winter's Wrath arc you land on him accelerates his sustain, which is exactly backwards from how poke usually works.
audit.corrected: Untargetability, the knockback wording, the correct passive name and the Sap Magic acceleration are all now stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere. breakdown.cooldowns said only 'count its cooldown before stepping up'.
audit.why: Real numbers: Twisted Advance 14/13/12/11/10s at 525 range, Bramble Smash 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s, Sapling Toss 18/17/16/15/14s at 1100 range, Nature's Grasp 130/110/90s.
audit.corrected: Numbers added, with the sequencing rule 'never spend Permafrost or R into the dash'.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal timing anywhere despite Sap Magic being his lane engine.
audit.why: Sap Magic heals on attack and its cooldown shortens whenever he is struck by a spell. Grievous Wounds is therefore worth more here than the page implies.
audit.corrected: Recorded; the point reaches the page through the Key Ability Interactions rewrite rather than a new itemization line, to stay inside the length band.

edits.before: Maokai's Twisted Advance root (W) lets him stick to you and force extended trades your early damage can't win — respect it and don't let him root you into a minion wave.
edits.after: Twisted Advance (W, 14s at rank 1) goes untargetable mid-dash and roots on arrival — never spend Permafrost into the dash, and never let him root you into the wave.

edits.before: Stack Frost with W both strikes and detonate Permafrost (E) the instant he commits a Twisted Advance root
edits.after: Stack Frost with both W strikes and fire Permafrost after his W lands, never into the untargetable dash

edits.before: Poke your passive Permafrost armor off with saplings before committing, so your resistance window is already depleted
edits.after: Chip Fury of the North's Frost Armor off with saplings first, so your resists are gone before he roots you

edits.before: At Level 3 his W root into sapling burst plus Q knockup is a full rotation; your Q-W-E chain deals damage but his passive healing wins the sustained trade.
edits.after: At 3 his W root into Sapling Toss plus a Bramble Smash knockback is his rotation, and Sap Magic's heal refreshes off every spell you land on him.

edits.before: Glacial Prison is a comet he cannot dash out of — land it outside his W range, blizzard him in place, Q charge in, and Permafrost (E) his full Frost stack for the first reliable kill attempt.
edits.after: Glacial Prison outranges his 525 W by a mile — but Twisted Advance goes untargetable mid-dash, so throw R before he presses it, then Q charge in and Permafrost the full stack.

edits.before: - Maokai Twisted Advance (Root): matchup-defining — Point-and-click root — count its cooldown before stepping up. Count it out loud if you must. - Your Q dash has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Maokai Twisted Advance (W): 14/13/12/11/10s at 525 range — he is UNTARGETABLE for the dash, so never spend Permafrost or R into it. - Bramble Smash (Q): 5-7s knockback. - Nature's Grasp (R): 130/110/90s. - Sap Magic's heal refreshes off every spell you land on him.

notes: Sample size is small (53 games in the packet, 58.49% in MC_WR_TABLES) so I moved only the two stages the existing prose already claimed, rather than rebuilding the chart. The biggest real error found: both layers state or imply Maokai has no dash — Twisted Advance is a dash AND grants untargetability, which inverts the level-6 advice the page gives. Bramble Smash is a knockback in Riot's text; the page called it a knockup in three places and I fixed the two that fell inside the band (content.early still says 'Q knockup' and content.late says 'Q knockback' — a later pass should make early consistent).
